products.title: USB-C Right Angle Cable
products.description: Flat 90-degree USB-C ribbon extension cable designed for tight spaces, tablet enclosures, and clean kiosk installs. 20cm length with up to 30W power delivery.
products.descriptionHtml:
Low-Profile USB-C Ribbon Extension Cable – 90° Male to Female

Flat 90° USB-C ribbon extension (male to female) for mounting behind tablets, kiosks, and panels. 20cm, up to 30W, low profile so the run stays flush.

It also works as a standalone 20cm FPC extension for POS counters, Raspberry Pi or other single-board setups, and flush wall dashboards—anywhere a thick round cable adds depth. Use it alone to finish an existing kiosk or panel. If you need a complete VESA / single-gang Tab A9+ mount, our enclosure kit already includes this cable.

The female USB-C end allows easy connection to your preferred power source or USB-C accessory.

USB 2.0 data transfer speeds

Flexible ribbon design for discreet routing

⚠️ Note: Not compatible with all USB-C fast charging protocols or high-speed data accessories (e.g. video output or USB 3.x devices).
products.featureHighlight: Perfect for low profile cases and mounts

products.title: Tablet Enclosure Kit - Samsung Tab A9+
products.description: Tab A9+ enclosure for kiosks, POS, and wall mounts. VESA / single-gang. Flat USB-C cable included.
products.descriptionHtml:
Samsung Tab A9+ Enclosure Kit

Tamper-resistant enclosure for the Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+. Built for visitor kiosks, POS, and wall-mounted dashboards. Mounts on VESA 75 or a US single-gang wall box.

The kit includes our flat right-angle USB-C cable so the tablet can sit flush—no thick round cord behind the case. Buttons, cameras, and mics stay accessible.

3D printed in the USA (ABS). Tablet and power adapter not included.

What’s in the box

  • SlateSafe enclosure for Galaxy Tab A9+
  • Low-profile right-angle USB-C cable
  • Assembly hardware
